item.title: Tired of these damn politics, man
item.description: EmilyQ: 80% of Americans generally agree on 80% of the issues, but the two parties don’t govern for the 80% of us who agree. This is a great point, but the 80% of Americans who agree want to ram it down the throats of those who don’t…and, on the 20% of issues without agreement, someone still wants to ram it down someone else’s throat. That’s how the powerful control a group that greatly outnumbers them.
